meta.basis: Illustrative full-ownership acquisition model. Retained seller equity is a proposed deal option, not implemented in calculations.

limitations: Inputs are planning assumptions, not verified target-company performance or committed financing.
Revenue and EBITDA in monthly rows are annualized month-end run rates. firmRevenue and firmEbitda are monthly amounts. Sum monthly amounts for earned-period totals.
Later acquisition sizes use a count-weighted average, not a distribution of actual deal sizes; large-ticket cash timing may differ.
Income taxes, capital expenditure, working-capital changes, transaction taxes and exit fees are excluded. EBITDA is not net income or distributable cash.
All presets use 10 years; this is a planning/terminal-value horizon, not a fund term or required sale.
Retained seller equity, minority distributions and local partner buyouts are not modeled. Do not apply full-ownership returns to a partial-ownership deal.
Seed-investor returns use illustrative 50% participation only when there is no later equity funding. With a later round they are null, not zero or unchanged.
Cash failure stops the simulation. Valuation and investor return availability flags must be respected.
Client equivalents are annualized revenue divided by an assumed $5,000 annual fee, rounded up; not a count of verified or deduplicated clients.
Historical market datasets have different units and years; do not add firm, establishment and nonemployer counts.
Per-firm margin improvement, organic growth, future bank access and acquisition throughput require evidence. Platform service-fee economics are not modeled separately.

capital.meaning: Total seed commitment; paid through gates if tranches=true

scaleDeals.meaning: Capacity from month 25; zero uses deals

hqPerFirm.meaning: Additional central cost per acquired firm from month 25

rev.meaning: Entry annual revenue of launch acquisitions

revAfter.meaning: Blended entry revenue of acquisitions from month 25; zero means same as rev

priceAfter.meaning: Purchase price / revenue for new acquisitions from month 25; zero uses price

targetAfter.meaning: Integrated margin of new acquisitions from month 25; zero uses target

price.meaning: Purchase price divided by entry revenue

ramp.meaning: Linear improvement from entry to target margin

growth.meaning: Annual gross new revenue rate; net monthly change=(growth-churn)/1200

cac.meaning: Acquisition-marketing expense as a share of gross new revenue

hqGrowth.meaning: Annual base overhead increase from month 37

deals.meaning: Acquisition capacity in first 24 months; cash can reduce purchases

bank.meaning: Bank share once available; seller finances residual

creditMonth.meaning: Bank availability, always at least month 25

reserve.meaning: Central overhead cash reserve used by acquisition gate

close.meaning: Closing costs paid separately from price

div.meaning: Annual share of cash above reserve distributed after divStart

monthly.openingCash: Cash before monthly funding and operations, USD
monthly.postAcquisitionCash: Cash after funding and purchase outlays, before operations, USD
monthly.equityIn: Seed plus later equity funding received in month, USD
monthly.seedIn: Seed tranche received in month, USD
monthly.downPayment: Buyer contribution to purchase prices in month, USD
monthly.closingCosts: Purchase closing costs in month, USD
monthly.purchasePrice: Total purchase price of new firms, USD
monthly.bankDraw: Bank debt funded directly toward purchases, USD
monthly.firmRevenue: Combined firm revenue earned this month, USD
monthly.firmEbitda: Combined practice EBITDA this month, before central overhead and CAC, USD
monthly.firmOperatingCosts: Practice operating costs this month, USD
monthly.cac: Gross-new-revenue acquisition cost this month, USD
monthly.service: Acquisition debt principal + interest paid this month, USD
monthly.interestPaid: Acquisition loan interest paid this month, USD
monthly.principalPaid: Acquisition loan principal repaid this month, USD
monthly.operatingSurplus: Monthly firm EBITDA minus central overhead and CAC, before debt/tax, USD
monthly.ebitda: Annualized month-end platform EBITDA, after central overhead and CAC, USD/year
monthly.distribution: Total company distribution this month before seed share, USD

annual.cashAfterDebt: Platform EBITDA earned minus debt principal and interest, before taxes/capex/working capital/new acquisitions/distributions, USD
annual.annualizedPlatformEbitda: Year-end platform EBITDA run rate, USD/year
annual.capitalReceived: Seed and later equity received during year, USD
annual.distributions: Company cash distributions during year, USD

summary.investorIrr: Annualized decimal rate, e.g. 0.15 = 15%; null when unavailable
summary.investorMoic: Total seed investor receipts / actual seed funding; null when unavailable
summary.firstBillionMonth: First modeled equity value >= USD 1 billion, subject to funding; null means not reached
summary.enterpriseValue: Annualized ending platform EBITDA, floored at zero, times multiple
summary.equityValue: Enterprise value minus debt plus cash, floored at zero

ventureAnalysis.basis: Fixed preset comparisons. USD; revenue/EBITDA are annualized year-end rates. Not investor returns.
ventureAnalysis.aiBasis: All firms fully mature at the stated margin; revenue and central/CAC costs held fixed. No adoption date, additional cash generation or terminal valuation is forecast. 80% is an unverified long-term hypothesis.

market.methodology: Economic Census: TAXSTAT=00, NAICS2022=5412 or 541211, GEO_ID=0100000US or 0400000US06. RCPTOT is in thousands of USD, converted to dollars above. CBP: lfo=-, fipstate=06 for California; n-prefixed fields count establishments by paid employment size. NES: LFO=-, RCPTOT_SIZE=001 at national level, ST=06 for California; NES RCPTOT remains in original thousands of USD. Employer firm counts, establishment counts and nonemployer businesses are different units; years are not combined.

referenceFacts.limits: Self-reported scale and task-level savings; not audited EBITDA uplift or a purchase-price benchmark.
Firm-count perimeter not reconciled with June release. Do not infer acquisition pace.
Planned program spend, not completed investment, enterprise valuation or per-firm price.
Price and full partner ownership terms undisclosed.
Price and exact ownership percentages undisclosed.
Approximate announcement values, not a small-practice multiple. Non-attest and attest businesses had separate purchasers.
Service revenue, not profit or a standard royalty rate.
Selected marketplace sample. SDE differs from EBITDA after replacement compensation.
CAS respondent sample, not the whole CPA market or a validated staffing plan for AGP.
Windows start in 2020. Not a count of completed sales or a current forecast.

targetProfile.status: Proposed screening preferences; not observed market metrics or binding terms
targetProfile.owner: Growth-minded continuing operator; age is not a filter
targetProfile.retainedSellerEquity: Preferred where agreed; no fixed percentage; not in calculator
